metadata.question: Did surface water extent increase along the Indus River floodplain in Pakistan between July 1, 2022 and August 28, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Indus River floodplain in Pakistan (major river, need to define a representative region) - Time periods: July 1, 2022 (before) vs August 28, 2022 (during/after floods) - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR (better for flood detection during monsoon/clouds) - Sentinel-1 is ideal since it penetrates clouds and Pakistan floods in 2022 were heavily clouded 2. Masking strategy: - Use Sentinel-1 VV polarization for water detection - Lower backscatter values indicate water (VV < -15 dB threshold) - No cloud masking needed for SAR data 3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: - Valid comparison: Both dates have images and valid pixels → A (increased) or B (didn't increase) - C1: No Sentinel-1 images for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Need to compare water extent between the two dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Indus River floodplain region in Pakistan (Sindh province area) const indusRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[67.5, 24.0], [69.5, 24.0], [69.5, 28.0], [67.5, 28.0], [67.5, 24.0]] ]); // Define time periods const date1 = '2022-07-01'; const date2 = '2022-08-28'; // Function to get water extent for a specific date function getWaterExtent(targetDate) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(indusRegion) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-3, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(3, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); return col; } // Get collections for both dates const col1 = getWaterExtent(date1); const col2 = getWaterExtent(date2); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 1 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`August 28 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Create mosaics and detect water (VV < -15 dB) const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); const water1 = img1.lt(-15); const water2 = img2.lt(-15); // Calculate water extent in square meters const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const waterExtent1Obj = await water1.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: indusRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterExtent2Obj = await water2.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: indusRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterExtent1 = waterExtent1Obj.VV; const waterExtent2 = waterExtent2Obj.VV; // Count valid pixels const count1Obj = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: indusRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1 = count1Obj.VV; if (count1 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (waterExtent1 === null || waterExtent2 === null || waterExtent1 === undefined || waterExtent2 === undefined || isNaN(waterExtent1) || isNaN(waterExtent2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const extent1_km2 = (waterExtent1 / 1e6).toFixed(2); const extent2_km2 = (waterExtent2 / 1e6).toFixed(2); const change = ((waterExtent2 - waterExtent1) / 1e6).toFixed(2); const pctChange = (((waterExtent2 - waterExtent1) / waterExtent1) * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`July 1 water: ${extent1_km2} km2`); console.log(`Aug 28 water: ${extent2_km2} km2`); console.log(`Change: +${change} km2 (${pctChange}%)`); if (waterExtent2 > waterExtent1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
